main_text.l: geschrieben seyn/ inn ein ander verständliches
weiß zubringen/ welcher meynung dann Herr
Pirckheimer gewesen/ wie auß seinem Schreiben
seinem lieben Freund Albrecht Dürer alles gutes.
welches mir vor diesem von einem sehr guten vertrawten
allein von wegen unser gegeneinander bender-

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "I" is read as the first letter of "Ist"; the first word is taken as "Ist" from the long-s ligature. The word "Schwartzenberg" is uncertain (printed form looks like "Schwarkenberg") and is not marked in the text. "bender-seyts" is a line-end break; the hyphen is faint and may be a printer's mark, so the word is kept as printed. The line "vor diesem" may have a hyphen at "die-sem" that is not clear on the scan. No catchword or signature is visible. The ornamental rules between the blocks are not text and are omitted.
